banner.heading: Your privacy choices
banner.summary: Storage the app needs to sign you in and hold offline inspections, plus one optional item that remembers your theme. No analytics, no ads, no trackers.
banner.body: We use a small amount of browser storage to keep you signed in and to hold inspections you complete while offline. That storage is required for the app to work. One optional item remembers your theme.
banner.noTracking: No analytics. No advertising. No third-party trackers. We do not sell or share your personal information.

gpc.heading: Opt-Out Preference Signal Honored
gpc.body: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal. We have recorded an opt-out for you and stored nothing optional. You do not need to do anything else.

settings.heading: Privacy choices
settings.body: Change what this browser stores. Withdrawing is as easy as granting, and takes effect immediately.
settings.currentGranted: Optional storage is on for this browser.
settings.currentDenied: Optional storage is off for this browser.
settings.never: You have not made a choice on this browser yet.

categories.name: Strictly necessary
categories.description: Keeps you signed in, and stores inspections you complete without a connection until they can be uploaded. The app cannot function without these.
categories.items: Supabase authentication session, offline inspection queue (IndexedDB), your saved privacy choice

categories.name: Preferences
categories.description: Remembers your light or dark theme choice and whether you have already seen the intro animation. Turning this off does not limit any feature.
